newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close lower on retail selling.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close lower on retail selling.

text.p: Heavy retail selling pulled down prices across the board on the Dhaka bourse at the close on Wednesday, brokers said.

The benchmark price index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) finished 57.98 points or 5.21 percent down at 1,054.07 on a turnover of 40.5 million taka. Of 107 traded issues, 103 lost, three gained and one closed flat.
Brokers said retail selling amid a nagging fund shortage and low-key presence of the institutions led the drop.
Bangladesh Tobacco Company Ltd lost 12.44 taka to 139.10 and Monno Fabrics shed 9.21 to 131.14.
